 India Today Video Desk UPDATED: Oct 24, 2026 18:17 IST A fresh spell of snowfall across the upper reaches of the Kashmir Valley has led to a significant drop in temperatures across the region. In the plains, night temperatures have dropped to between four and five degrees Celsius, while daytime temperatures in Srinagar are declining between 14 and 16 degrees Celsius. The Meteorological Department has forecast continued snowfall in the upper reaches over the next 24 hours. Razdan Pass, the high-altitude route connecting Gurez Valley with Bandipora, received another fresh spell following an earlier recording of nearly eight inches of snow, drawing visitors and signalling the arrival of winter tourism.

 5:06 INDIA Bloc To Hold Mock Parliament In Delhi To Impeach CEC Gyanesh Kumar 
 The opposition INDIA bloc is planning to organize a mock parliament at the Ashoka Hotel in New Delhi on October 30. During the event, proceedings will be held to symbolically pass a motion for the impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. All constituent parties of the bloc are expected to participate. The move aims to project opposition unity and send a message alleging that the Chief Election Commissioner is not functioning in accordance with the Constitution. In parallel, opposition parties are also preparing an actual impeachment notice to be moved in Parliament. The draft notice is currently being circulated among members of Parliament, requiring signatures from 100 Lok Sabha members and 50 Rajya Sabha members to be submitted to the respective secretariats ahead of the upcoming parliamentary session.
 5:35 Jamia Shifts To Online Classes Amid Hunger Strike Over Student Polls And Row Over Slogans 
 Jamia Millia Islamia has decided to conduct all classes online with immediate effect until further notice, citing campus safety concerns amid ongoing student demonstrations. Students at the central university have been staging protests and a hunger strike to demand the restoration of the student union elections, the revocation of student suspensions and campus bans, and the resignation of the Chief Proctor following clashes with campus security guards. The controversy intensified after slogans mentioning Kashmir, Sharjeel Imam, the RSS, and the BJP were seen on university walls before being removed. The demonstrations took a political turn after opposition members of Parliament, including Congress leader Imran Masood and Samajwadi Party leader Mohibullah Nadvi, were detained by Delhi Police while attempting to meet the protesting students at Gate Number Seven. While opposition leaders questioned the suspension of students and demanded union polls, the BJP termed the graffiti an anti-national conspiracy.
 4:52 Andhra Local Polls Halted; CM Naidu Accuses YSRCP of Violence, Opposition Hits Back 
 The State Election Commission has halted the local body election process across 100 urban local bodies in Andhra Pradesh following Supreme Court directions. The decision came after the YSRCP challenged the alleged denial of nomination access for its candidates. Meanwhile, Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu accused YSRCP cadres of orchestrating unrest, presenting video footage of alleged attacks, intimidation, and arson at a press conference. In response, YSRCP chief Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy and party leaders countered the allegations, accusing the state administration and ruling Telugu Desam Party of misusing state machinery, using violence, and preventing opposition candidates from filing nomination papers.
 advertisement 2:21 Noida Sector 125 Fire: 1 Dead as Blaze Engulfs Multiple Shops Following Blast 
 A massive fire broke out in Sector 125 of Noida, engulfing five to six temporary shops adjacent to each other. The incident falls under the jurisdiction of the Sector 126 police station. Fire department and police personnel reached the spot to extinguish the blaze and conduct search and rescue operations. Eyewitnesses reported hearing the sound of a blast before the blaze spread, with multiple cooking gas cylinders found inside the premises. One person lost their life in the incident. Firefighting teams brought the blaze under control, and cooling operations remain underway to establish the exact cause of the fire.
